title: Champions League: Today's Games and Second Round Surprises
seoTitle: Champions League: Today's Games and Second Round Surprises
subtitle: Barcelona Stages Comeback, Bayern and Inter Stumble, and Sporting Leads Group Stage
excerpt: On Tuesday (13), the Champions League group stage's second round saw a Barcelona comeback, unexpected defeats for Bayern and Inter, and new leaders.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Today's matches, October 13, marked the return of the Champions League with nine games in the second round of the group stage. The results altered the standings and brought attention to some teams that changed positions.

Barcelona's Comeback and Shared Leadership

Barcelona defeated Galatasaray in Istanbul after conceding the first goal. Lamine Yamal, who provided two assists, scored the second and third goals with Fermín and Gordon. The Spanish team finished the match with four goals, leading the competition with six points, alongside Sporting and Arsenal.

Bayern and Inter's Defeats Surprise

Bayern Munich drew with Viking, from Norway, despite having turned the score around with two goals from Kane and one from Luis Díaz. The draw occurred after Olise's expulsion in the final minutes. Meanwhile, Inter Milan lost at home to Club Brugge, with a final score of 3-1, increasing the pressure on the Italian campaign.

Sporting Takes the Lead

Sporting beat Lens away 2-0, with goals from Suárez and Doumbia. The result propelled the Portuguese club to the top of the table, sharing the lead with Barcelona and Arsenal, both with six points.

Other Round Matches

In addition to the highlights above, the round featured Arsenal defeating Lille 3-0, with goals from Timber, Eze, and Saka. Atlético Madrid overcame Liverpool, while Manchester United beat Sabah. RB Leipzig defeated PSV, and Villarreal came back to beat Napoli 3-1. In Norway, Bayern played against Viking; in Italy, Inter faced Club Brugge; and in France, Lens hosted Sporting.

With information from UOL, GZH, VEJA.
